title: What Has Been Lost with Synthetic Evaluation?
reasoning: The paper investigates the methodology of creating reasoning-over-text benchmarks using LLMs, specifically focusing on negation (CondaQA) and quantitative reasoning (DROP). While some experimental passages mention religious topics (e.g., religious demographics or historical figures associated with the Church), these are incidental content for testing linguistic reasoning rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religion, morals, or ethics.
